## Description

GET verification (hub.mode, hub.verify_token, hub.challenge) and POST events checked with X-Hub-Signature-256 against the per-tenant app secret from Key Vault. Store each inbound message once by provider id, answer 200 quickly, process in a job. Outbound text and template sends with backoff retries; delivery and read statuses update the message. Per-tenant phone number and business account. MDV-P4-028 reminders send through this adapter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A webhook with a bad or missing signature is refused; a replayed message id is processed once (tests with recorded synthetic payloads).
- [ ] **AC2.** A send that fails transiently is retried with backoff; a permanent failure marks the message failed and shows in integration health.
- [ ] **AC3.** Two tenants with different numbers never see each other's events.
- [ ] **AC4.** The adapter is not claimed to work with Meta until a real sandbox number is connected and recorded in the ticket.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
